why_agent_cannot: the drop requires a Telegram or Discord account session
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the games page Go to the SOMO games page to see the three games the site presents: Battle Ground, Duel and Tap Tap Tripps.
2 Step 2 : Look at Battle Ground Open Battle Ground to see the grid-based 1v1 tactics game made for mobile.
3 Step 3 : Look at Duel Open Duel , the turn-based game where you collect cards, build decks and duel other players.
4 Step 4 : Open Tap Tap Tripps Open Tap Tap Tripps , the Telegram game where you tap your team of Tripps, collect Gold and buy upgrades.
5 Step 5 : Read the tokenomics page Read the SOMO tokenomics page to see how the SOMO token and its allocations are described.
